answer_normalization.common: Unicode NFKC; casefold; normalize curly quotes/dashes; collapse whitespace; remove thousands separators only between digits; trim outer whitespace and terminal punctuation
answer_normalization.numeric: Strip $, commas, percent sign, and scale words only after checking explicit-unit compatibility; parenthesized numbers are negative

count_handling.accepted: Exactly one finite non-negative integer after the common numeric normalization; explicit scale words are rejected.
count_handling.comparison: candidate integer must equal reference integer exactly

full_semantic_answer_accuracy.arithmetic: Numeric value match under the frozen tolerance; an explicit incompatible unit fails, while omission of the reference scale is compatible.
full_semantic_answer_accuracy.denominator: 506 qualified table-text questions; the single predeclared NOT_MODEL_READY item is excluded before any model output.
full_semantic_answer_accuracy.multi_span: All normalized gold spans must occur in the normalized candidate as word-boundary substrings; order is ignored and extra candidate text is allowed.
full_semantic_answer_accuracy.span: Normalized equality or normalized word-boundary containment in either direction is accepted.
unknown_reasonable_only_if: ambiguity_visible was frozen true before model output because multiple legal interpretations remain from visible evidence
